title: A genuinely busy chat — every relationship, including the ones that cost nothing
notes: Built to exercise everything the classifier now has to tell apart:
chit-chat that should cost nothing, an amendment that should be rewritten
rather than concatenated, a follow-up that depends on an earlier answer,
a duplicate within one household, the same words from a different member
(not a duplicate), and an ambiguous 'no' that should be asked about
